articles.title_en: Intermediation and Voluntary Exposure to Counterparty Risk
articles.title_cn: 中介与对手方风险的自愿暴露
articles.abstract_en: I study a model of the financial sector in which intermediation among debt-financed banks gives rise to an endogenous core-periphery network. Endogenous intermediation generates excessive systemic risk in the financial network. Financial institutions have incentives to capture intermediation spreads through strategic borrowing and lending decisions. By doing so, they tilt the division of surplus along an intermediation chain in their favor, while at the same time reducing aggregate surplus. The network is inefficient relative to a constrained-efficient benchmark, since banks that make risky investments “overconnect,” exposing themselves to excessive counterparty risk, while banks that mainly provide funding end up with too few connections.
articles.abstract_cn: 我研究了一个金融部门模型，其中债务融资银行之间的中介活动产生了内生核心-外围网络。内生中介在金融网络中产生了过度的系统性风险。金融机构有动机通过战略性借贷决策来获取中介利差。通过这样做，它们使中介链上的剩余分配向自身倾斜，同时减少了总剩余。相对于受约束的有效基准，该网络是低效的，因为进行风险投资的银行“过度连接”，使自身暴露于过度的对手方风险，而主要提供资金的银行最终连接过少。

articles.abstract_en: In traditional over-the-counter markets, investors trade bilaterally through intermediaries. We assess whether and how to shift trades on a centralized platform with trade-level data on the Canadian government bond market. We document that intermediaries charge a markup when trading with investors and specify a model to quantify price and welfare effects from market centralization. We find that many investors would not use the platform, even if they could, because it is costly, competition for investors is low, and investors value relationships with intermediaries. Market centralization can even decrease welfare, unless competition is sufficiently strong.
articles.abstract_cn: 在传统的场外交易市场中，投资者通过中介机构进行双边交易。我们利用加拿大政府债券市场的交易层面数据，评估是否以及如何在集中化平台上转移交易。我们记录了中介机构在与投资者交易时收取加价，并构建了一个模型来量化市场集中化带来的价格和福利效应。我们发现，许多投资者即使可以使用该平台，也不会使用，因为成本高昂，投资者之间的竞争较低，且投资者重视与中介机构的关系。除非竞争足够激烈，否则市场集中化甚至可能降低福利。

articles.title_en: Reserve Prices in Internet Advertising Auctions: A Field Experiment
articles.title_cn: 互联网广告拍卖中的保留价格：一项实地实验
articles.abstract_en: We present the results of a large field experiment on setting reserve prices in auctions for online advertisements, guided by the theory of optimal auction design suitably adapted to the sponsored search setting. Consistent with the theory, revenues increased substantially after the new reserve prices were introduced.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们展示了一项关于在线广告拍卖中设定保留价格的大型实地实验结果，该实验以最优拍卖设计理论为指导，并适当调整以适应赞助搜索环境。与理论一致，引入新的保留价格后，收入显著增加。

articles.title_en: Learning Efficiency of Multiagent Information Structures
articles.title_cn: 多智能体信息结构的学习效率
articles.abstract_en: Which information structures are more effective at eliminating first- and higher-order uncertainty and hence at facilitating efficient play in coordination games? We consider a learning setting where players observe many private signals about the state. First, we characterize multiagent learning efficiency, that is, the rate at which players approximate common knowledge. We find that this coincides with the rate at which first-order uncertainty disappears, as higher-order uncertainty vanishes faster than first-order uncertainty. Second, we show that with enough signal draws, information structures with higher learning efficiency induce higher equilibrium welfare. We highlight information design implications for games in data-rich environments.
articles.abstract_cn: 哪些信息结构在消除一阶和高阶不确定性方面更有效，从而在协调博弈中促进有效博弈？我们考虑一个学习环境，其中玩家观察关于状态的许多私人信号。首先，我们刻画了多智能体学习效率，即玩家近似共同知识的速率。我们发现这与一阶不确定性消失的速率一致，因为高阶不确定性比一阶不确定性消失得更快。其次，我们表明，在足够的信号抽取下，具有更高学习效率的信息结构会带来更高的均衡福利。我们强调了数据丰富环境中博弈的信息设计启示。

articles.abstract_en: We use laboratory experiments to test models of rational inattention, in which people acquire information to maximize utility net of information costs. We show that subjects adjust their attention in response to changes in incentives, in line with the rational inattention model. However, our results are qualitatively inconsistent with information costs that are linear in Shannon entropy, as is often assumed in applied work. Our data are best fit by a generalization of the Shannon model, which allows for a more flexible response to incentives and for some states of the world to be harder to distinguish than others.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们使用实验室实验来检验理性疏忽模型，在该模型中，人们获取信息以最大化扣除信息成本后的效用。我们表明，受试者会根据激励的变化调整其注意力，这与理性疏忽模型一致。然而，我们的结果在性质上与香农熵线性的信息成本不一致，而这是应用研究中经常假设的。我们的数据最适合于香农模型的一种推广，该推广允许对激励做出更灵活的反应，并允许某些世界状态比其他状态更难区分。

articles.title_en: Supply Chain Resilience: Should Policy Promote International Diversification or Reshoring?
articles.title_cn: 供应链韧性：政策应促进国际多元化还是回流？
articles.abstract_en: Little is known about optimal policy in the face of global supply chain disruptions. Should governments promote resilience by subsidizing backup sources of input supply in multiple countries? Should they encourage firms to source from safer domestic suppliers? We address these questions in a model of production with a critical input and exogenous risks of supply disturbances. With constant elasticity of substitution preferences, a subsidy for diversification achieves the constrained social optimum. When the demand elasticity rises with price, private investments in resilience may be socially excessive and the social planner may wish to discourage diversification while favoring sourcing from abroad.
articles.abstract_cn: 关于全球供应链中断时的最优政策，我们知之甚少。政府是否应通过补贴多个国家的备用投入品供应来源来促进韧性？他们是否应鼓励企业从更安全的国内供应商处采购？我们在一个具有关键投入品和供应中断外生风险的 production 模型中解决这些问题。在恒定替代弹性偏好下，多元化补贴实现了受约束的社会最优。当需求弹性随价格上升时，私人韧性投资可能在社会上过度，社会规划者可能希望抑制多元化，同时偏向于从国外采购。

articles.title_cn: 随机搜索下的多维排序
articles.abstract_en: We analyze sorting in a frictional labor market when workers and jobs have multidimensional characteristics. We say that matching is positive assortative in dimension (j, k) if workers with higher endowment in skill k are matched to a job distribution with higher values of attribute j in the first-order stochastic dominance sense. Crucial for sorting is a single-crossing property of technology. Sorting is positive between worker-job attributes with strong complementarities but negative in other dimensions. Finally, sorting is based on comparative advantage: workers sort into jobs that suit their skill mix rather than their overall skill level.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们分析了当工人和工作具有多维特征时，摩擦性劳动力市场中的排序。我们说，如果技能k禀赋较高的工人按照一阶随机占优意义匹配到属性j值较高的工作分布，则匹配在维度(j, k)上是正分类匹配的。对排序至关重要是技术的单交叉性质。在工人-工作属性之间具有强互补性的维度上，排序是正的，但在其他维度上是负的。最后，排序基于比较优势：工人会进入适合其技能组合的工作，而不是其整体技能水平。

articles.title_en: Minimum Wage and Individual Worker Productivity: Evidence from a Large US Retailer
articles.title_cn: 最低工资与个体工人生产率：来自美国大型零售商的证据
articles.abstract_en: We study workers who are employed by a large US retailer, work in many store locations, and are paid based on performance. By means of a border-discontinuity analysis, we document that workers become more productive and are terminated less often after a minimum wage increase. These effects are stronger among workers whose pay is more often supported by the minimum wage. However, when workers are monitored less intensely, the minimum wage depresses productivity. We interpret these findings through an efficiency wage model. After a minimum wage increase, profits decrease, and a calibration exercise suggests that worker welfare increases.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了受雇于一家美国大型零售商、在许多门店工作且按绩效计酬的工人。通过边界断点分析，我们记录了最低工资上调后工人生产率提高且被解雇的频率降低。这些效应在工资更常受最低工资支持的工人中更为显著。然而，当工人受到的监督强度较低时，最低工资会抑制生产率。我们通过效率工资模型来解释这些发现。最低工资上调后，利润下降，而校准练习表明工人福利增加。

articles.title_en: The Neolithic Agricultural Revolution and the Origins of Private Property
articles.title_cn: 新石器时代农业革命与私有财产起源
articles.abstract_en: Familiar explanations of why hunter-gatherers first took up farming—superior labor productivity, population pressure, or adverse climate—receive little support from recent evidence. Farming would be an unlikely choice without possession-based private property, which appears to have existed among rare groups of sedentary hunter-gatherers who became the first farmers. Our model shows that among them, farming could have benefited first adopters because private possession was more readily established and defended for cultivated crops and domesticated animals than for the diffuse wild resources on which hunter-gatherers relied, thus explaining how farming could have been introduced even without a productivity advantage.
articles.abstract_cn: 关于狩猎采集者为何首先从事农业的常见解释——优越的劳动生产力、人口压力或不利气候——很少得到近期证据的支持。如果没有基于占有的私有财产，农业将是一个不太可能的选择，而这种私有财产似乎存在于少数成为首批农民的定居狩猎采集者群体中。我们的模型表明，在他们中间，农业可能使首批采用者受益，因为对于栽培作物和驯养动物而言，私有占有比狩猎采集者所依赖的分散野生资源更容易建立和捍卫，从而解释了即使在没有生产力优势的情况下，农业是如何被引入的。

articles.title_en: The Effects of Fluoride in Drinking Water
articles.abstract_en: Water fluoridation is a common but debated public policy. In this paper, we use Swedish registry data to study the causal effects of fluoride in drinking water. We exploit exogenous variation in natural fluoride stemming from variation in geological characteristics at water sources to identify its effects. First, we reconfirm the long-established positive effect of fluoride on dental health. Second, we estimate a zero effect on cognitive ability in contrast to several recent debated epidemiological studies. Third, fluoride is furthermore found to increase labor income. This effect is foremost driven by individuals from a lower socioeconomic background.
articles.abstract_cn: 水氟化是一项常见但有争议的公共政策。在本文中，我们使用瑞典注册数据来研究饮用水中氟化物的因果效应。我们利用水源地质特征差异引起的天然氟外生变异来识别其影响。首先，我们再次确认了氟化物对牙齿健康的长期公认的积极影响。其次，与近期几项有争议的流行病学研究相反，我们估计氟化物对认知能力的影响为零。第三，还发现氟化物能增加劳动收入。这一效应主要由来自较低社会经济背景的个体驱动。

articles.abstract_en: Growth in this model is driven by technological change that arises from intentional investment decisions made by profit-maximizing agents. The distinguishing feature of the technology as an input is that it is neither a conventional good nor a public good; it is a nonrival, partially excludable good. Because of the nonconvexity introduced by a nonrival good, price-taking competition cannot be supported. Instead, the equilibrium is one with monopolistic competition. The main conclusions are that the stock of human capital determines the rate of growth, that too little human capital is devoted to research in equilibrium, that integration into world markets will increase growth rates, and that having a large population is not sufficient to generate growth.
articles.abstract_cn: 该模型中的增长由技术变革驱动，而技术变革源于利润最大化主体的有意投资决策。技术作为投入品的显著特征在于，它既非传统商品，也非公共物品；它是一种非竞争性、部分排他性的商品。由于非竞争性商品引入的非凸性，价格接受竞争无法维持。相反，均衡是垄断竞争下的均衡。主要结论是：人力资本存量决定增长率；均衡中投入研究的人力资本过少；融入世界市场将提高增长率；拥有大量人口并不足以产生增长。

articles.title_en: Robots and Jobs: Evidence from US Labor Markets
articles.title_cn: 机器人与就业：来自美国劳动力市场的证据
articles.abstract_en: We study the effects of industrial robots on US labor markets. We show theoretically that robots may reduce employment and wages and that their local impacts can be estimated using variation in exposure to robots—defined from industry-level advances in robotics and local industry employment. We estimate robust negative effects of robots on employment and wages across commuting zones. We also show that areas most exposed to robots after 1990 do not exhibit any differential trends before then, and robots’ impact is distinct from other capital and technologies. One more robot per thousand workers reduces the employment-to-population ratio by 0.2 percentage points and wages by 0.42%.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了工业机器人对美国劳动力市场的影响。我们从理论上表明，机器人可能会减少就业和工资，并且其局部影响可以通过机器人暴露度的差异来估计——该暴露度由行业层面的机器人技术进步和当地行业就业情况定义。我们估计了机器人对通勤区就业和工资的稳健负效应。我们还表明，在1990之后机器人暴露度最高的地区在此之前并未表现出任何差异趋势，并且机器人的影响与其他资本和技术不同。每千名工人增加一个机器人，就业人口比下降0.2个百分点，工资下降0.42%。

articles.title_en: The Pricing of Options and Corporate Liabilities
articles.abstract_en: If options are correctly priced in the market, it should not be possible to make sure profits by creating portfolios of long and short positions in options and their underlying stocks. Using this principle, a theoretical valuation formula for options is derived. Since almost all corporate liabilities can be viewed as combinations of options, the formula and the analysis that led to it are also applicable to corporate liabilities such as common stock, corporate bonds, and warrants. In particular, the formula can be used to derive the discount that should be applied to a corporate bond because of the possibility of default.
articles.abstract_cn: 如果期权在市场上被正确定价，那么通过构建期权及其标的股票的多头和空头头寸组合来确保利润应该是不可能的。利用这一原则，推导出了期权的理论估值公式。由于几乎所有公司负债都可以被视为期权的组合，该公式及其分析也适用于诸如普通股、公司债券和认股权证等公司负债。特别是，该公式可用于推导因违约可能性而应对公司债券应用的折价。
